vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Graduate from any recognized University; Retired Judicial Employee from the category of Chief Administrative Officer/ Senior Superintendent. Experience required: Retired as Member of TJMSS with satisfactory record of service. Age limit: Must not have completed 65 years of age as on the date of application (retired judicial employees). Pay: Rs.40,000 (Retired Judicial Employees only). Qualification required: Must have passed any exam between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent examination, but the candidate having higher qualification than 10th class shall not be considered eligible. salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.40,000 per month (Senior Superintendent, retired judicial employees only); Rs.15,600 per month (Office Subordinates), consolidated

how_to_apply: Fill the application proforma printed on page 4 of the notification and affix a passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer.
Enclose attested copies of the listed documents and a self-addressed registered postal envelope with acknowledgment (RPAD).
Mention the name of the post applied for.
Send the application in a sealed cover addressed to the Principal District Judge, Nirmal by Ordinary Post/Registered post/courier.
Applications must reach by 5.00 PM on 05-12-2026; applications are not entertained directly or in person.
important_instructions: Applications received after 5.00 PM on 05-12-2026 will not be accepted Applications will not be entertained directly or in person Applications with insufficient information will be summarily rejected No TA/DA for journey for examination/skill test, oral interview or appointment No correspondence will be entertained; candidates bringing influence will be disqualified

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for Nirmal District Court Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Office Subordinates (Attender): SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years, Physically disabled 10 years. Other conditions: Applications invited from retired judicial employees and eligible candidates from Nirmal District Retired applicants must have retired as Members of TJMSS in corresponding or higher categories with satisfactory record of service Retired applicants must be of sound health and active habits, with proven record of ability, good performance and integrity Selected persons must produce a Fitness Certificate and enter into an Agreement/Contract with the Principal District Judge, Nirmal

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract basis under Rule-9 of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for two years or earlier date, or continued till further orders Deed of Agreement to be executed at the time of appointment Contract ceases automatically unless a fresh proposal is made and fresh contract entered into For retired employees, monthly amount is in addition to terminal benefits For retired employees, Telangana Civil Service (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and Telangana Pension Code apply mutatis mutandis

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Nirmal District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Nirmal District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk), 2 Office Subordinates (Attender).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Nirmal District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma on page 4 of the notification) and send it to The Principal District Judge, Nirmal, by ordinary post/registered post/courier in a sealed cover, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk): must not have completed 65 years of age as on the date of application (retired judicial employees); Office Subordinates (Attender): must have completed 18 years and must not have completed 46 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.40,000 (Retired Judicial Employees only) for Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk), Rs.15,600 for Office Subordinates (Attender).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Superintendent (Head Clerk): Graduate from any recognized University and retired Judicial Employee from the category of Chief Administrative Officer/Senior Superintendent. Office Subordinate (Attender): passed any exam between 7th to 10th class or equivalent; candidates with higher qualification than 10th class are not eligible. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications invited from retired judicial employees and eligible candidates from Nirmal District. Retired applicants must have retired as Members of TJMSS in corresponding or higher categories with satisfactory record of service. Retired applicants must be of sound health and active habits, with proven record of ability, good performance and integrity. Selected persons must produce a Fitness Certificate and enter into an Agreement/Contract with the Principal District Judge, Nirmal.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employees dismissed, removed, compulsorily retired or made to seek retirement on Medical Invalidation. Retired persons who received any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service. Office Subordinate candidates with qualification higher than 10th class.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Oral Interview. Eligible candidates will be called for oral interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis under Rule-9 of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for two years or earlier date, or continued till further orders. Deed of Agreement to be executed at the time of appointment. Contract ceases automatically unless a fresh proposal is made and fresh contract entered into.
